fields.title: What is a section?
fields.body: Sections are an optional method to break the estimate into logical pieces. For example, you may have a roof and a midfloor that you want as a separate parts within the estimate. All estimates will have at least 1 section to it and it can be whatever you want it to be.

fields.title: What are Section Areas?
fields.body:
All sections have at least one area.
Sections can have multiple areas so for example a midfloor may have a tiled floor in a specific zone where joist spacing may need to be closer than the rest of the floor. This feature allows the user to designate the different zones and their construction.
